analysis: The PR changes only CHANGELOG.md, adding a documentation entry at the top (lines 3-5 in head), 'Unreleased — canceled PostgreSQL debits'. The entry says a PostgreSQL debit stays uncommitted until its statement succeeds, so a row-lock wait that timed out cannot later become a charge, and that a lost commit acknowledgement stays uncertain and must not be blindly retried. This relates to A-009 (payment ledger) and TB-008 (coordinator to payments). The PR does not include the code change, so I could not verify the described behavior. No security-relevant code, configuration, or trust-boundary changes are visible. No new attack surface, regression, or invalidated threat-model assumption. The next review pass should check the actual ledger debit and transaction code that implements this, if it is in another PR or a different batch. The other changelog contents are unchanged context, including mentions of T-031 and SEC-035.
